paper_title: PyramidInfer Pyramid KV Cache Compression for High-throughput LLM   Inference
caption: Comparison between PyramidInfer and full cache baseline with different batch sizes on the LLaMA 2-7B model with input length of 512+256.
model_annotation: The line plot compares the throughput (in tokens per second) of PyramidInfer and the Full Cache baseline across varying batch sizes, using the LLaMA 2-7B model with an input length of 512+256. The x-axis represents the batch size, ranging from 0 to 60 with major tick marks at intervals of 20, and is labeled "Batch Size." The y-axis represents throughput in tokens per second, scaled from 0 to 2500 with major tick marks at intervals of 500, and is labeled "Throughput (token/s)." The plot displays two lines: the pink line with circular markers, labeled "PyramidInfer," shows a steady increase in throughput as batch size increases, starting at approximately 300 tokens/s at a batch size of 1 and rising to over 2500 tokens/s at a batch size of 60. The green line with circular markers, labeled "Full Cache," shows a different trend: it increases from approximately 100 tokens/s at a batch size of 1 to a peak of about 1250 tokens/s at a batch size of 32, then decreases to around 950 tokens/s at a batch size of 60. The data points for both lines are clearly visible, and the overall trend for PyramidInfer is consistently upward, while the Full Cache shows a peak and then a decline.
